programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: A 10-year-old boy with an aging disease that makes him appear to be 40 is finally allowed to go to school. After entering the fifth grade, he has difficulty making friends.

programme.title: Aakhri Chaal : Ab kaun bachega
programme.desc: Three brothers conspire against each other in a bid to take over their father's criminal empire following his sudden death. Meanwhile, someone else tries to take advantage of the rift between them.

programme.title: Zulmi
programme.desc: Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister.

programme.title: Triple R Rocky Rahul Rambo
programme.desc: Three students, who fail their exams and waste their time, befriend Mitra in their college. They devise a plan to help her, but it leads to various problems.

programme.title: Saindhav
programme.desc: A man with a traumatic past is compelled to encounter a crime boss so that he can rescue his daughter from a health problem.

programme.title: Seetharamam
programme.desc: Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.

programme.title: Revolver Rita
programme.desc: A woman begins to chase down the culprits after her handbag is stolen. However, things take a turn when the thieves find weapons in their loot, causing them to question the identity of their victim.

programme.title: Aatma Ka Ghar
programme.desc: A series of ominous events unfurl when a newly married couple move into a house haunted by a voyeuristic spirit that soon becomes fixated on the wife.

programme.title: Aatma Ka Ghar 2
programme.desc: Mohini and Harsha relocate to a different city to escape the haunting of an evil spirit only to later realize that the spirit is still hot on their trail.

programme.title: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: A teacher names a tribal student Bhagat Singh and instils strong moral values in him. Later, the young man battles injustice and formidable adversaries to defend his community.

programme.title: Yudh Ek Jung
programme.desc: Chandu, a supermarket employee, encounters trouble after he decides to help Indu, an aspiring actor. But when he gets embroiled in a murder case, a dark secret from his past resurfaces.

programme.title: Arjun Reddy
programme.desc: Arjun Reddy Deshmukh, a young surgeon with functioning alcoholism and a furious temper, spirals into self-destruction when he learns that his girlfriend is marrying another man.

programme.title: Gollu Aur Pappu
programme.desc: Two brothers, Gollu and Pappu, confront Gustaad Khan, a terrorist, for blowing up their garage. However, he decides to take advantage of their innocence by making them deploy a bomb in Ludhiana.

programme.title: Morbius

programme.title: The Equalizer 3

programme.title: Fatherhood
